title: Biswanath Chariali
sub: From Assampedia, the free Assam encyclopedia
body:
Biswanath Chariali is a town in north Assam and the headquarters of Biswanath district, on the north bank of the Brahmaputra.

Places

Nearby Biswanath Ghat, on the river, is known for its temples and river views. The town is a market and transport centre for the surrounding tea gardens and agricultural area.
